test_title: PYST 9 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If all novels are books and some books are boring, which of the following must be true?
solution: Given statements: All novels are books. Some books are boring. Option 1) Some novels are boring – Not true (Some books are boring, but it doesn’t mean any novels are boring.)
